title: English Practice Quiz 0946
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: He asked, 'Where do you live?'
options: He asked where do I live.
He asked where did I lived.
He asked where I live do.
questions.explanation: Reported questions use statement word order; do is removed.

questions.question: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound. Honest begins with a silent h.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'available'?
options: ready or able to be used
questions.explanation: Available means ready for use or accessible.

questions.question: You did not hear someone. You say:
questions.explanation: Could you repeat that, please? is a polite request.

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: 'You are ready, ___?'
questions.explanation: A positive statement with are usually takes the negative tag aren't you.
